subtopics.label: Neonatal Critical Care and NICU Management
subtopics.description: Research focused on clinical management of neonates in the NICU, including preterm infant care, neonatal resuscitation, respiratory support, hypoglycemia, neonatal abstinence syndrome, and quality improvement initiatives specific to the neonatal intensive care setting.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Intensive Care and Critical Illness Management
subtopics.description: Clinical research on management of critically ill children in the PICU, including sedation practices, delirium assessment and outcomes, early warning scores, tracheostomy timing, respiratory failure, and care transitions during the COVID-19 pandemic.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Transfusion Medicine and Hematology
subtopics.description: Research on blood product transfusion practices, bleeding assessment, anticoagulation, and hemostatic management in critically ill children, including those on ECMO, undergoing cardiac surgery, or with malignancy-related coagulopathy.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Epilepsy and Neurological Disorders
subtopics.description: Clinical and translational research on pediatric epilepsy including infantile spasms, status epilepticus, rare epilepsy syndromes, EEG-based diagnostics, glucose transporter deficiency, and neurological conditions such as Sturge-Weber syndrome and anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Brain Tumors and Neurosurgical Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on pediatric central nervous system tumors including DIPG, medulloblastoma, choroid plexus carcinoma, and low-grade gliomas, with focus on convection-enhanced delivery, molecular diagnostics, surgical approaches, and novel therapeutic strategies.

subtopics.label: Neurodevelopmental Disorders and Autism Spectrum Disorder
subtopics.description: Research on autism spectrum disorder and related neurodevelopmental conditions, including behavioral interventions, social skills training, diagnosis disclosure, caregiver-mediated strategies, and neurobiological mechanisms underlying ASD and ADHD.

subtopics.label: Adolescent Mental Health, Suicide, and Substance Use
subtopics.description: Research on mental health conditions in adolescents including depression, anxiety, suicidal ideation and attempts, substance use disorders, eating disorders, and the impact of social determinants, digital media, and COVID-19 on youth psychiatric outcomes.

subtopics.label: Pediatric COVID-19 and Infectious Disease
subtopics.description: Clinical research on SARS-CoV-2 infection in children and adolescents, including disease severity across variants, MIS-C, COVID-19 vaccination in pediatric populations, and management of other pediatric infectious diseases such as RSV, pneumonia, and sepsis.

subtopics.label: Congenital Heart Disease and Pediatric Cardiology
subtopics.description: Research on congenital heart disease management including tetralogy of Fallot, Fontan surgery, cardiomyocyte biology, cardiac surgery outcomes, and perioperative care in pediatric patients with structural heart defects.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Chronic Kidney Disease and Growth
subtopics.description: Research on chronic kidney disease in children and adolescents, including growth impairment, mineral bone disorder, anemia management, pubertal development, and iron therapy in pediatric CKD populations.

subtopics.label: Perinatal and Maternal-Neonatal Outcomes
subtopics.description: Clinical research on pregnancy complications, labor management, and perinatal outcomes including hypertensive disorders, oxytocin use, penicillin allergy in pregnancy, prenatal substance use policies, and neonatal outcomes associated with maternal conditions.

subtopics.label: Pediatric HIV, Vertical Transmission, and Immunization
subtopics.description: Research on mother-to-child HIV transmission, broadly neutralizing antibodies, pediatric HIV vaccine development, ART adherence in adolescents, and immune correlates of protection against perinatal HIV infection.

subtopics.label: Congenital CMV and Perinatal Vaccine Immunology
subtopics.description: Research on congenital cytomegalovirus transmission, maternal immune correlates of protection, placental antibody transfer, and vaccine development strategies for perinatal pathogens including CMV, rotavirus, and other neonatal infections.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Obesity, Diabetes, and Metabolic Health
subtopics.description: Research on obesity, type 2 diabetes, prediabetes, and metabolic syndrome in children and adolescents, including bariatric surgery outcomes, dysglycemia screening, dietary patterns, and corneal biomarkers of diabetic neuropathy.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Telemedicine, Medical Education, and Workforce
subtopics.description: Research on telemedicine implementation in pediatric care, medical education and training for pediatric residents and fellows, simulation-based learning, and workforce well-being including burnout and compassion fatigue among pediatric providers.

subtopics.label: Childhood Cancer Survivorship and Late Effects
subtopics.description: Research on long-term health outcomes, late effects (cardiotoxicity, hearing loss, underweight mortality), screening utilization, and quality of life in survivors of childhood and young adult cancers. Includes genetic counseling, contraception counseling, and survivorship training programs.

subtopics.label: CLN2 Batten Disease and CNS Gene Therapy
subtopics.description: Studies on CLN2-associated Batten disease including retinal degeneration, gene therapy with AAVrh.10 vectors administered intracranially or intracisternally, and long-term survival outcomes. Includes safety, biodistribution, and efficacy of direct CNS gene delivery.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Traumatic Brain Injury and Neurorehabilitation
subtopics.description: Research on cognitive and motor recovery, imaging predictors, assistive technology access, anesthesia exposure, and rehabilitation outcomes following pediatric traumatic brain injury. Includes cognitive assessment tools and covert cognition detection.

subtopics.label: Adolescent Sexual and Reproductive Health
subtopics.description: Studies on sexual and reproductive health education, counseling, and interventions for adolescents including refugee girls, those with epilepsy, and young adults undergoing cancer treatment. Includes pelvic exam practices, HPV vaccination, and privacy laws.

subtopics.label: Child Maltreatment, Foster Care, and Family Violence
subtopics.description: Research on child abuse, neglect, foster care involvement, and family violence prevention, including the impact of Medicaid expansion, prenatal drug use laws, parental opioid use disorder, and health insurance on child welfare outcomes.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Gastrointestinal Disease and Inflammatory Bowel Disease
subtopics.description: Studies on pediatric gastrointestinal conditions including inflammatory bowel disease, eosinophilic esophagitis, celiac disease, microscopic colitis, and microvillous inclusion disease. Includes VTE complications in IBD, body image, and synbiotic interventions.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Oncology and Hematologic Malignancies
subtopics.description: Research on pediatric cancers including AML, Hodgkin lymphoma, neuroblastoma, sarcomas, and myeloproliferative neoplasms, covering cytogenetics, treatment outcomes, VTE management, and healthcare transition. Includes delirium in hematopoietic cell transplant.

subtopics.label: Chiari Malformation, Craniosynostosis, and Pediatric Neurosurgery
subtopics.description: Studies on Chiari malformation classification, revision surgery, occipital condyle screw fixation, craniosynostosis repair outcomes, and related neurosurgical procedures in children. Includes imaging metrics, transfusion volume, and rickets complications.

subtopics.label: Neonatal and Fetal Brain Imaging and Neurodevelopment
subtopics.description: Research on advanced MRI techniques for fetal and neonatal brain imaging including diffusion MRI atlases, cerebral blood flow trajectories, susceptibility mapping, and reduced field-of-view imaging. Includes longitudinal neurodevelopmental analysis in preterm infants.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Pulmonology, Asthma, and Respiratory Disease
subtopics.description: Studies on pediatric asthma risk factors including sphingolipid synthesis, mouse allergen exposure, rhinovirus infection, and bronchopulmonary dysplasia nutrition and imaging. Includes croup management, obstructive sleep apnea in infants, and aerodigestive evaluation.

subtopics.label: Social Determinants of Health, Health Equity, and Child Well-being
subtopics.description: Research examining how social determinants of health, racial disparities, socioeconomic factors, and care coordination gaps affect child health outcomes, mental health, and healthcare utilization. Includes intersectionality analyses and medical home domains.

subtopics.label: Adolescent Substance Use, Neurobiology, and E-cigarettes
subtopics.description: Studies on adolescent substance use including alcohol, cannabis, opioids, and e-cigarettes, examining neurobiological mechanisms, mental health comorbidities, policy impacts, and behavioral interventions. Includes endocannabinoid genetics and vaping trends.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Infectious Disease in Global and Resource-Limited Settings
subtopics.description: Research on pediatric infectious diseases in low-resource settings including tuberculosis, HIV, febrile illness management, and care-seeking behavior. Includes TB preventive therapy, isoniazid resistance, and integration of TB/HIV services.

subtopics.label: Maternal Infections, Pregnancy Complications, and Perinatal Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies on infections during pregnancy including hepatitis B, hepatitis C, SARS-CoV-2, and HSV, examining maternal and neonatal outcomes, vertical transmission risk, and treatment strategies. Includes placental pathology and penicillin allergy evaluation.

subtopics.label: Child and Adolescent Mental Health, Psychopathology, and COVID-19 Impact
subtopics.description: Research on child and adolescent mental health including depression, anxiety, psychopathology risk factors, psychiatric emergency presentations, digital media impacts, and COVID-19 pandemic effects on mental health. Includes ACEs, parenting, and behavioral interventions.
